modules.name: Sofonisba
modules.description: Dual-section multiple arbitrary function generator with per-stage voltage, time, and modifier control

modules.name: Lucia
modules.description: Compact single-stage-slot variant of Sofonisba: same dual-section engine, one visible stage slot instead of 16 parallel columns

modules.name: Amilcare
modules.description: Trigger/CV expander for Sofonisba: Clear, Reset Values, 12 preset loads, Scale/Key select, Start/End of Cycle outputs

modules.name: Bianca
modules.description: Poly CV expander for Sofonisba: additive Stage Time/Curve/Warp CV and per-stage Gate A/B outputs

modules.name: Europa
modules.description: Quad function generator with VCA: four independent Delay/Attack/Hold/Release envelope generators with audio-rate capable times, One-Shot/Sustain modes, internal loop and poly time CV

modules.name: Minerva
modules.description: Dual voltage processor: per section attenuverter, crossfader between two inputs with CV and offset, polyphonic with individual settings for all 16 channels

modules.name: Elena
modules.description: Control voltage processor: two transfer-curve sections with input select, breakpoint and individual settings for all 16 channels, plus six slew limiters with rate/time mode and auto-pulse

modules.name: Anna-Maria
modules.description: Quad low-pass gate with VCA mode, vactrol-style response and optional resonance
